rows.en: Look! The rocket's flying off!

Riderman… You did well!

You saved humanity! You're a hero! I bestow on you… the name "Kamen Rider 4"!

…Riiidermaaan!

Riderman… You did well!

You saved humanity! You're a hero! I bestow on you… the name "Kamen Rider 4"!

…Riiidermaaan!
Riderman…
Riderman…
Riderman…
Riderman…
Are you all right!? Riderman?
V3! Hurry and stop the rocket launch!
Curse youuu! You Riders!
…!? Wait!
All right! I've stopped the Pluton Rocket launch!
We did it! The Pluton Rocket exploded! We stopped the launch!

Marshal Armor… the Pluton Rocket launch has failed! There is no more time to waste!

I have made my final decision! Marshal Armor, begin Operation D at once!
This is terrible! Destron has started Operation D! There are surprise attacks all over Japan…
And… Oyassan and Taki are…!
What!? Operation D? So that's Operation D!?
Unless we crush Destron's Great Leader, all of Japan is doomed!
This is bad! Destron started Operation D! Surprise attacks all over Japan!
Unless we crush Destron's Great Leader, all of Japan is doomed!
Damn… Destron, I won't forgive you!
The Great Leader and Marshal Armor are in here! Come on, let's go!
So you've come! I've been waiting for you!
Marshal Armor… Where are Oyassan and Taki!?
Right here!
Shiro! Never mind us!
Marshal Armor… Take this guy down!

These two are to be executed shortly for the crime of defying Destron!

And… you will die too!

What!? Marshal Armor… you I will never forgive!

Kazami, take care of Oyassan and Taki!

Got it! Yuki, be careful!

Senpai, let's go!

What!? Marshal Armor, I won't forgive you!

Senpai, take care of Oyassan and Taki!
Right… I'll rescue them, I promise! You be careful too.
Here I come! Marshal Armor!
Here I come! Marshal Armor!

Hahaha…

So you've finally made it this far, Kamen Riders!
So you're Destron's Great Leader!? Show your true form!
Whoever sees my true form must die! That is the law of Destron!

Silence! V3 doesn't fall for empty threats like that! I'll expose your true form right now!

Toh!
Hahaha…

…!?

A skeleton…?
Indeed! I am the Grim Reaper… who brings death to the humans of Earth!

Its heart is still alive!?

Reaper, go to hell! Toh!
So this was the Great Leader's true form!?

Well done uncovering my true form! I'll give you that…

With this, I die! But… you will all die with me!
…!? He's going to self-destruct!? Get out, quickly!
…!? He's going to self-destruct! Let's get out, quickly!
Destron has vanished from the face of the Earth… That's one more evil organization gone!

…!?

Come to think of it… what happened to Yuki? Where did he go at a happy time like this?
He's dead…
Dead!?
I bestowed on him… the name Kamen Rider 4! Please pray for his soul…
Kamen Rider… 4…

You all did great…

Oh, that's right!

Yuki, Destron is destroyed! Your nemesis Marshal Armor is dead too… You'll accept that offer we talked about, won't you?
That offer…?
Yes! I'll gladly accept!
What's this about, Yuki…

The truth is, Yuki…

no, Dr. Yuki… You all know he was one of Destron's top scientists, right?

The TDF was impressed by his skills and invited him to put the scientific power of evil to work for peace.

But he kept refusing until he'd defeated Destron and Marshal Armor.
So that's how it was…
Keeping quiet about it… that's not very friendly of you.

From now on, I'm ready to fight alongside all of you as a member of the TDF Science Group!

I'm counting on you all!
I bestow on you… the name Kamen Rider 4!
Kamen Rider 4?
Thank you, Kazami…
Riderman died valiantly, protecting humanity from Destron's evil clutches… Soul of Riderman, rest in peace!
The dreaded Destron was destroyed. But the Great Leader's whereabouts remain completely unknown, and many enemy organizations still remain…
Even so, the warriors go on… believing in the end of a battle that may never end.
And they march on, carrying the soul of the man who fought for peace…
The dreaded Destron was destroyed. But the Great Leader's whereabouts remain completely unknown, and many enemy organizations still remain…
Even so, the warriors go on… believing in the end of a battle that may never end…
What…!?
Uwaaaaah…
Defeat the Executive Monster Zariganna and all Destron Combatants!
Defeat the revived executive monsters, the Shocker Riders and all Destron Combatants!
Defeat the Grand Executive Monster Zariganna!
Secret agent Makoto Arai received promising information about Desper City from the FBI…

The entrances to Desper City… from District A to District L, open for only 15 minutes a day, on an RT-system cycle…

District A, east-southeast 0531125… I've got it! This is Desper City!
Then… your wife and daughter are there too, Mr. Arai?

Mm, most likely…

…Wait!

There seems to be more to the information…

Geisel apparently plans to carry out his final plan in the next few days…

It's believed to be an operation to destroy all of Japan using an artificial sun…

…!?

We have to stop this no matter what!
Yes! This time, it may be our final battle!
Right, let's do it!

U12034: 陽予 read as 猶予 "time to waste".
U12038/U12040: 全士 read as 全土 "all of Japan".
U12058: コケ落し read as コケ脅し "empty threats".
U12069-U12083: two routes: in one Riderman died (U12069-U12072, U12084-U12087), in the other he survives (U12073-U12083, U12088-U12089).
U12087: 敬った read as 戦った "fought".
U12092-U12094: 幹割坊心 read as 幹部怪人 "executive monster", 襞餌 as 再生 "revived", 備幹割 as 大幹部 "grand executive", 魔込員 as 戦闘員, 中て as 全て. Reconstructed; please verify.
U12096: RT方式 and the code 0531125 kept as written.
omissions_kept: U12079: Kotaro's line addressed to Yuki, implied.
